_note: The look of every screen ("Ranger Camp": summer camp, ranger stations, painted wood and brass): colors, fonts, text sizes, spacing, corners and the chunky components (panels, buttons, pills, cards, signs). Screens use these through scripts/ui/style/ui_style.gd and never pick their own colors or sizes. The chunky pieces are textures drawn by tools/make_ui_art.py and tinted with these colors. Sizes are in game pixels: the layout is 720 wide, so on an iPhone 1 pixel is about 0.54 pt (26 px is about 14 pt, 88 px about 48 pt).

colors._note: Every color, defined once: warm sunny yellows, leaf greens, sky blues and wood browns, all solid and saturated (nothing see-through; disabled and locked things are solid muted gray, not faded). The chunky pieces are shaded textures tinted with these. Groups: the Ranger Camp look (match screens), rarities, classes, habitats, the home screen's blue look (kit_*), sorting, and a few one-off pieces.
colors._rarity: Card frames and rarity text, everywhere a rarity shows (rarities.json has no colors of its own).
colors._class: Class badges and headers (classes.json has no colors of its own).
colors._habitat: Habitat badges, card windows and Biome headers (habitats.json has no colors of its own).
colors._kit: The menus' own Ranger Camp colors (scripts/ui/ui_kit.gd): the backdrop from a summer sky (kit_bg_top) to sunshine (kit_bg_bottom), panels of painted wood (kit_panel; darker wood kit_panel_dark for wells and slots, light wood kit_panel_light for what is picked), dark wood (kit_deep) for tracks, chips and name plates, a dark brown outline (kit_ink) and outlined white and cream text. The action colors are the match's own (green, blue, red, gold).
colors._sort: Sorting (data/sorting.json): the Level groups, the Mythics' Legends group, animals not found yet, and tools.
colors._pieces: One-off pieces: Your Deck's tray and empty slots, the ban coin, the info popup's stat bars and their track, the Ranger Journal's lines, the first-boss reward panel, scroll bars, and the solid muted tint over an arena you haven't reached.
colors._show: The rarity card show (feel.json card_show): the Rare shine, the light sweeping across Epic cards, the Legendary sparkles, the Mythic sparkles, its light rays behind the animal and its flash; the moment's burst colors.

kit._note: The menus' panels (ui_kit.gd raised(), inset(); style/kit_box.gd): the painted-wood pieces a match uses. A box under chip_under pixels tall is drawn as a chip, a taller one as a panel. edge and lip: the room its outline and its bottom lip take inside it. well_dark: how much darker a well is than the color it is given. A ring round a picked panel (a ready cage, your arena) glows glow_grow pixels out. body_outline: the outline of body text, as a share of its size. rim_light: how much lighter a picked tab is than the bar.

fonts._note: display: titles, numbers and buttons (thick outline and drop shadow). body: the few longer lines.

text_sizes._note: The only four sizes. Nothing smaller than small (about 14 pt on an iPhone).

space._note: Padding and gaps: always one of these.

button._note: A button's darker lip under the face makes it look pressable; pressed, the face sinks onto it. min_height is the smallest touch target.

card._note: The frame is the rarity color, and nothing else on a card is (its level badge and bar are the same for every rarity); selected cards get a thick selected-color outline and lift. An animal card's bottom: its level on a round badge (level_badge: its radius as a share of the strip's height) and under it, in the collection, a small bar filling with copies toward the next upgrade (level_bar_width: a share of the card's width inside the frame; level_bar_height: a share of the strip's height): blue, green with an arrow once it can be upgraded, gold at the top level.

screen._note: safe_area_extra adds a little room under a notch and above the home bar on top of what the phone reports.
